alloc_for_extend: allocate KV cache for extend batch and write to req_to_token_pool
alloc_for_decode: allocate KV cache for decode batch and write to req_to_token_pool
alloc_req_slots: allocate request slots from the req_to_token_pool for a list of requests
alloc_token_slots: allocate token slots from the tree cache KV pool allocator
release_kv_cache: release KV cache and mamba state for a finished request
